html:
Choosing to have a Total Knee Replacement (TKR) is a great first step toward restoring a pain-free existence. One of the most frequent and important questions we’re asked at Silver Touch Hospitals is: How long will my new knee last?

Advances in orthopaedic surgery and prosthetic technology have substantially improved the life span of knee implants. We believe that with the right combination of surgical expertise, advanced technology, and personalised post-operative care, your new joint can provide comfort and mobility for decades.

The Role of Surgical Precision

The life of your replacement knee begins in the operation theatre. It’s not merely a matter of inserting a new joint; it’s one of perfect alignment and balance. Even the best quality implant material will degrade more quickly if it is implanted incorrectly. This exacting procedure needs the high level of training and experience held by an expert knee replacement surgeon in Ahmedabad.

At Silver Touch Hospitals, our surgeons emphasise careful technique to guarantee:

  • Optimal Alignment: Accurate positioning of the components to ensure even weight distribution around the joint, reducing stress and wear on the polyethylene spacer.
  • Soft Tissue Balance: Maintaining the ligaments around the knee neither too loose nor too tight permits the knee to function naturally, and is vital to implant function and patient comfort.

The technique of the surgeon has a direct impact on how smoothly the knee works and, in turn, how long the components will last.

Taking Advantage of Current Implant Technology

We select materials and technology with durability in mind. Today’s implants are unlike those implants from twenty years ago. The orthopaedic community continues to improve with a desire to develop materials that are stronger and better at withstanding wear.

Important technological advances that increase the life of your knee:

  • Advanced Bearing Surfaces: Highly cross-linked polyethylene significantly minimizes wear and tear against older plastics.
  • Durable Metals: Materials such as titanium and cobalt-chrome alloys for the metal parts guarantee strength and durability within the joint structure.

A good knee replacement surgeon in Ahmedabad knows how to choose the right implant design and material for you, depending on your age, activity level, and bone quality, to maximise the years you get out of your replacement.

Maximising Longevity Through Post-Operative Care

Surgery is just half the longevity puzzle. The last piece is how you take care of your knee after surgery. Our post-op care plan includes:

  • Rehabilitation: Compliance with the prescribed course of physiotherapy is mandatory. Strong muscles are essential to give the new joint proper support, protecting it against excess stress.
  • Activity Modification: Although we promote activity, avoiding high-impact sports such as running or forceful jumping safeguards the joint against excessive loosening or wear.
  • Regular Check-ups: Regular follow-ups, such as X-rays, enable us to track the position of the implant and detect any early wear or loosening, catching any minor problems before they become significant.

By blending finer surgical technique with innovative materials and thorough recovery, we work with you to give your new knee a lasting, quality solution for chronic pain.
